mapper.select: SELECT oor.return_add_time, oor.return_message, oor.return_type, oor.return_method_status, oor.shop_name, oor.return_shop_message, oor.return_shop_handle, oor.order_goods_num, oor.order_id, oor.return_code, oor.return_voucher, oor.buyer_user_account, oor.return_reason, oor.return_cash, oor.return_state, oor.return_finish_time, oor.return_addr_name, oob.buyer_user_name, oob.order_receiver_name, oob.order_receiver_address, oob.order_receiver_contact, oob.payment_number, oob.payment_name, oob.order_create_time, oob.payment_time, oob.order_payment_amount, oob.payment_name, oob.order_shipping_fee, oob.order_type, oor.return_shipping_code, oor.return_post_code, oor.return_mobile, oob.drop_shipping, IF(oob.drop_shipping = 1, IF(oob.deliver_shop_id = oob.shop_id, 1, 0), 1) operate, oob.drop_shipping, sob.order_refund_price AS supper_refund_price, sob.order_return_price AS supper_return_price, sob.goods_payment_amount AS supper_payment_amount, rp.intervention_state, oor.expiration_time, oob.order_source, oob.payment_code FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oor.order_id = oob.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob ON sob.order_id = oob.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return_platform rp on oor.order_id = rp.order_id WHERE oor.return_code = #{returnCode}
select return_state FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return where return_code = #{returnCode} limit 1

select oor.return_shop_handle, oor.return_state, oor.return_code, oor.return_cash, oor.return_commision_fee, oor.return_reason, oor.return_add_time, oor.return_shop_message, oor.return_shop_time, oor.order_id, oor.buyer_user_account, oor.shop_name, oob.payment_name, oob.payment_number, oob.order_payment_amount, oob.payment_code, oor.return_payment_voucher, oor.return_method_status FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob on oor.order_id = oob.order_id where oor.return_code = #{returnCode}

select obart.return_code,obart.barter_shipping_code,obart.barter_post_code,obart.barter_mobile, obart.order_return_id,obart.order_id,obart.return_code,obart.create_time,obart.barter_status, obart.delivery_time, obart.order_barter_id,obart.barter_post_name FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_barter obart where obart.return_code = #{returnCode}

SELECT oor.order_id, oor.shop_id, oor.return_cash, oor.return_code, oor.return_state, oor.return_add_time, oob.buyer_user_name, oob.order_status FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oob.order_id = oor.order_id WHERE oor.return_state = 1 AND oor.return_type = 3 AND oob.order_status = 6 AND oob.original_order IS NULL AND HOUR(TIMEDIFF(now(), oor.return_add_time)) > 48

select oor.order_id, oor.return_cash, oor.return_code, oor.return_state, oor.return_add_time, oob.buyer_user_name, oob.order_status FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob on oob.order_id = oor.order_id where oor.return_state = 6 and oor.return_type = 3 and oob.order_status = 29 AND oob.original_order IS NULL and HOUR( TIMEDIFF(now() , oor.return_add_time)) > 23
select oor.order_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor where oor.return_state = 19 and oor.return_type = 3 and DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) > oor.return_finish_time;
select oor.order_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor where oor.return_state in (2,3,10) and oor.return_method_status = 4 and now() > oor.expiration_time

SELECT rp.order_id, rp.return_code, rp.return_state, oor.order_seller_address, oor.order_seller_name, oor.order_seller_contact, os.storage_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return_platform rp LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oor ON rp.order_id = oor.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_shipment os ON rp.order_id = os.order_id WHERE rp.intervention_state = 0 AND rp.return_method_type = 3 AND now() > rp.expriation_time
